title: TradeGoldConfirmChain - the trade-gold dialog confirm path is fully traced end to end; msg 0x405 is NEVER sent by this build: (a) the gold-dialog confirm (0x418520 ENTER/SPACE or 0x418600 click) sends 0x7EE with wParam=((type<<8|row)<<16)|msgId = 0x03000405 to [0x8AB7B0], which routes to 0x41DFE0 -> 0x42D650 (always returns 0) -> [0x8AA4A4] never populated; (b) the sole 0x405 wire sender 0x451B00 is reachable only from 0x417280 (gate matches wParam 0x03000405 exactly), which is reachable only from 0x42D680 dl=3, whose only caller 0x41CEC2 needs an 0x7ED message with byte3(wParam)==3 - no such sender exists (only chat 0x7ED wParam in {0,1})
objective: Trace the complete confirm chain of the trade-gold dialog (global object 0x7E04C8, type byte 3, msgId 0x405): from key/click input through the [0x8AB7B0] window message bus to any network send. Determine whether msg 0x405 (trade gold) is ever transmitted by this Mir3.exe build, and correct the 0x42D680 dispatch attributions from round 8.
question: When the gold dialog is confirmed (ENTER/SPACE or button click), what exact message is sent, who receives it, and does a 0x405 wire packet ever result? What is the exact 0x42D680 dl->handler mapping?
method: Static disassembly of Mir3.exe (/tmp/mir3_full.asm): decode the dialog input handler 0x418470/0x418520/0x418600 (wParam packing, SendMessageA site), the window message bus 0x41E2B0 (0x7EE case 0x41E530), the 0x7EE receiver 0x41DFE0 (0x42D650 gate, 0x440740 stub, [0x8AA4A4] read), the 0x42D680 dispatch (raw jumptable 0x42D700 bytes, index = dl-3), the dl=3 handler 0x417280 (gate against low word 0x405 + bits16-23==0 + [0x7DA100] cap), the sole 0x405 sender 0x451B00, and complete caller enumeration of 0x42D680/0x417280/0x451B00 plus complete sender enumeration of 0x7ED/0x7EE (including byte3(wParam) of every 0x7ED sender).

confirm_input_path.keyboard_0x418520: gate [e + row*0xB8 + 0x234] != 0 (row = [e+0x462], focused row; only reached from 0x418470 on VK_RETURN 0xD or VK_SPACE 0x20). wParam packing 0x4185DD-0x4185E7: xor ecx,ecx; mov ch,byte[e] (type byte -> bits 16-23); mov dx,word[e+0x460] (msgId -> bits 0-15); mov al,byte[e+0x462] (row -> bits 8-15); shl eax,0x10; or eax,ecx -> wParam = ((type<<8)|row)<<16 | msgId. Gold dialog: type=3, row=0 (default focus), msgId=0x405 -> wParam = 0x03000405. GetWindowTextA([0x8AA48C], &[e+0x130], 0x104) captures the amount text; SetWindowTextA([0x8AA48C], string@0x8B187C = BSS zeros = empty); [0x8AA498] = 1; SendMessageA([0x8AB7B0], 0x7EE, 0x03000405, &[e+0x130]) @0x4185DB; then hide via 0x417FB0.
confirm_input_path.click_0x418600: gate [e+0x28] visible. Loop over 3 button rows (stride 0xB8, frames at [e+0x238]/[e+0x2F0]/[e+0x3A8], each skipped when word[row-4] (store at 0x234/0x2EC/0x3A4) == 0); hit-test via button vtable+0x10. On hit: mov ah,byte[e] (type); mov al,bl (row index); mov cx,word[e+0x460] (msgId); shl eax,0x10; or eax,ecx -> SAME packing ((type<<8|row)<<16)|msgId; [e+0x462]=row; MoveWindow(input rect); SendMessageA([0x8AB7B0], 0x7EE, wParam, &[e+0x130]) @0x4186CD; hide 0x417FB0.
confirm_input_path.wparam_meaning: bits 0-15 = msgId (word [e+0x460], set by ctor arg8); bits 16-23 = row (focused button row, [e+0x462]); bits 24-31 = dialog type byte ([e], set by ctor arg2). For the gold dialog: 0x03<<24 | 0x00<<16 | 0x405.

bus_0x41E2B0_7EE_case: wndproc of the [0x8AB7B0] window; vtable-installed (no direct call). Prologue sub esp,8 + push ebx/ebp/esi/edi; ebx=wParam(arg3), ebp=msg(arg2), edi=lParam(arg4), esi=this; ret 0x10 (hwnd,msg,wParam,lParam). msg 0x7EE -> case 0x41E530 (test eax,0xee; ja default / jmp [eax*4+0x41E690], table [0]=0x41E522 (0x7ED) [1]=0x41E530 (0x7EE) [2]=0x41E54B (0x7EF) [3]=0x41E56A (0x7F0)). 0x41E530: mov eax,[esp+0x28](lParam); mov ecx,[esp+0x24](wParam); push eax; push ecx; mov ecx,esi; call 0x41DFE0 -> 0x41DFE0(wParam, lParam), returns directly (no default forwarding).
receiver_0x41DFE0: 0x41DFE0(wParam, lParam): first call 0x42D650(ecx=this) -> guard [ecx+0x51180]; if nonzero: add ecx,0x51150; call 0x440740 -> 0x440740 = 'xor eax,eax; ret' permanent stub -> returns 0; if zero: returns 0. Either way eax == 0. Then mov dl,byte[0x8AA4A4] (0x41E00E) - the populated-command flag - and the chat-command parse/send path (0x4520F0 @0x41E22F, push 0x8AA4A4) is gated on it. [0x8AA4A4] has NO non-zero writer in the whole binary (only 4 zero-fill sites: 0x40274A, 0x4194FC, 0x41E245, 0x456CE4) -> the flag is always 0 -> 0x41DFE0 always returns with no send. This path CANNOT transmit 0x405.
wire_sender_0x451B00: sole 0x405 sender: mov eax,[esp+4](amount); lea edi,[esi+0x18]; push 0;push 0;push 0;push eax(amount);push 0x405;push edi; call 0x452940 -> packet {dword amount, word 0x405, word 0, word 0, word 0} (10 bytes); then 0x451E60(esi, edi, 0) sends. Only caller: 0x4172AE inside 0x417280.
gate_0x417280: 0x417280(wParam, lParam): cmp ax,0x405 (low word); jne skip; shr eax,0x10; test al,al; jne skip (bits 16-23 == 0, i.e. row 0); mov eax,[esp+8](lParam=amount text); call 0x4681F9 (amount parser); cmp eax,[0x7DA100]; jg skip (cap); push eax; mov ecx,0x8AB828; call 0x451B00. So the gate matches EXACTLY the dialog confirm wParam 0x03000405. Only caller of 0x417280: 0x42D6BA (the dl=3 entry of 0x42D680).
dispatch_0x42D680: 0x42D680(byte3 = bits 24-31 of wParam; only caller 0x41CEC2 = default case of the 0x7ED handler 0x41CDE0): mov eax,wParam; shr eax,0x10; mov dl,ah -> dl = byte3; lea eax,[edx-3]; cmp eax,6; ja default -> jmp [eax*4+0x42D700] with RAW table order (corrected round-8 attributions): index dl-3: dl=3 -> 0x42D6BA -> 0x417280 (0x405-gated gold sender); dl=4 -> 0x42D6D1 -> 0x425820; dl=5 -> 0x42D6F9 (xor eax,eax; pop esi; ret 8 - no-op); dl=6 -> 0x42D6A3 -> 0x4247C0 (0x3FC/0x3FD/0x3FE trade-message router); dl=7 -> 0x42D6F9 (no-op); dl=8 -> 0x42D6F9 (no-op); dl=9 -> 0x42D6E8 -> push [esp+0xc]; push esi; add ecx,0x51150; call 0x4404E0.
0x7ed_senders_complete: Every 0x7ED sender (SendMessageA/[0x476290] with msg 0x7ED): 0x450EA8 ('@' prefix, wParam=1, lParam=0) and 0x450EC2 (plain, wParam=0, lParam=0), both in the chat-edit input path 0x450CD0. byte3(wParam) = 0 in both cases -> 0x42D680 gets dl=0 -> default -> 0x41CEC2 -> 0x42D680 dispatches on dl=0: lea eax,[-3]; cmp eax,6; ja default (0x42D6F9 no-op). So 0x42D680 is a no-op for every 0x7ED that can actually arrive. The dl=3 branch (gold send) is statically unreachable.
0x42d680_reachability: Callers of 0x42D680: exactly one - 0x41CEC2 (default case of 0x41CDE0, the 0x7ED handler). Callers of 0x41CDE0: only 0x41E522 (the 0x7ED case of the [0x8AB7B0] bus). Therefore the gold-send branch of 0x42D680 can only be reached by an 0x7ED message with byte3(wParam)==3, and no such sender exists.
gold_ctor_site_corrected: The gold dialog ctor call is at 0x416F7E inside the trade-window click handler 0x416EF0 (NOT 0x417F50, which is an SEH thunk). 0x416EF0 (called from 0x42C017 = dispatch table 0x42C4D4 idx3 of the 0x42BE21 action handler; this = trade window [ROOT+0x3399C], arg1 = [ROOT+0x20]): inline strcmp([arg1+0x1C] == string@0x47ADB4) (0x416F2F-0x416F5F); on match, PtInRect [0x4762B4](&[trade+0x1C]+0x10E, x, y) = gold box rect hit; on hit: push 0x405; push -1; push -1; push 1; push 0x47AD98; push 1; push 3; push 0x565994; mov ecx,0x7E04C8; call 0x418030 -> arg1=0x565994 (context/parent), arg2=3 (type byte -> [e]), arg3=1 (2-button layout), arg4=0x47AD98 (prompt string -> [e+0x2C]), arg5=1, arg6=-1, arg7=-1 (centered from parent rect), arg8=0x405 (msgId word -> [e+0x460]); then rep stosd zeros 0x30E dwords.

strings.0x47AD98: GBK C4 FA D2 AA B8 B6 B8 F8 B6 D4 B7 BD B6 E0 C9 D9 BD F0 B1 D2 3F = '您要付给对方多少金币?' ('How much gold do you want to pay the other party?') - the gold-dialog prompt line, copied to [e+0x2C] by ctor arg4
strings.0x47ADB4: GBK B1 DD C0 FC = '陛傈' (2-byte garbled marker; NOT '确定' - that string, C8 B7 B6 A8, exists once at 0x7A371 in the login prompt '请按[确定]进入游戏.'). Used as the strcmp gate string by 0x416EF0 (gold-box click) and 0x416F00-family (trade stepper, F301)
strings.0x8B187C: BSS (zero-initialized, beyond .data raw coverage) - SetWindowTextA target string for clearing the input edit, i.e. empty text

verdict: CLOSED - msg 0x405 (trade gold) is NEVER sent by this Mir3.exe build. Both candidate routes are exhaustively dead: (a) the gold-dialog confirm sends 0x7EE 0x03000405 -> 0x41DFE0 -> 0x42D650 (guard + permanent stub 0x440740) -> [0x8AA4A4] never populated -> no send; (b) the only wire sender 0x451B00 is reachable only from 0x417280 (whose gate matches the confirm wParam exactly, but whose only caller 0x42D6BA is the dl=3 branch of 0x42D680), and 0x42D680's only caller needs an 0x7ED with byte3==3 - no such sender exists (only chat 0x7ED wParam in {0,1}, byte3=0). The trade-gold feature is dead code in this build; the 'gold box' click only ever pops the (equally non-sending) dialog.
conclusions: Gold dialog confirm: ENTER/SPACE 0x418520 or button click 0x418600 both send SendMessageA([0x8AB7B0], 0x7EE, ((type<<8|row)<<16)|msgId = 0x03000405, &[e+0x130]) - the amount text is in the lParam buffer, never parsed by any receiver.

0x7EE bus case 0x41E530 -> 0x41DFE0(wParam, lParam) -> 0x42D650: guard [ecx+0x51180] then 0x440740 which is a permanent 'xor eax,eax; ret' stub -> always 0. [0x8AA4A4] (the chat-command populated flag) is never written non-zero anywhere (4 zero-fill sites only) -> 0x41DFE0 can never send.

The only 0x405 wire sender is 0x451B00 (packet {dword amount, word 0x405, word 0, word 0, word 0}); its only caller 0x417280 gates exactly on wParam 0x03000405 (low 0x405 + bits16-23==0) and caps amount at [0x7DA100] (dead config: also never written).

0x417280's only caller is 0x42D6BA = the dl=3 entry of 0x42D680; 0x42D680's only caller is 0x41CEC2 (0x7ED default); 0x7ED is only ever sent by the chat edit with wParam in {0,1} (byte3=0) -> the dl=3 branch is statically unreachable. Both confirm routes are exhaustive dead ends.

Corrected 0x42D680 mapping (raw table 0x42D700 order, index = dl-3): dl=3 -> 0x417280 (gold-send branch; matches 0x03000405), dl=4 -> 0x425820, dl=5/7/8 -> no-op, dl=6 -> 0x4247C0 (0x3FC/0x3FD/0x3FE trade router), dl=9 -> 0x4404E0. Round-8's dl=3->0x4247C0 / dl=4->0x417280 attributions are superseded.

The trade-gold dialog is constructed by 0x416EF0 (gold-box click, strcmp gate vs '陛傈' + PtInRect) -> ctor 0x418030 @0x416F7E with arg2=3, arg4='您要付给对方多少金币?', arg8=0x405. Its confirm can never transmit: the whole gold-send chain is dead code in this build.

[INFERENCE] Server-side EI 3.0 builds may implement msg 0x405 over a different packet (or via a server command); this verdict is strictly about the client build under study. The deadness is proven by exhaustive caller/sender enumeration, not by absence of search.

closed_notes.round8_dispatch_correction: 0x42D680 mapping corrected per raw table order: dl=3 -> 0x417280 (the 0x405-gated gold sender) and dl=6 -> 0x4247C0 (0x3FC/0x3FD/0x3FE router). This resolves the 'type-3 vs type-4' nuance: the gold send branch is the type-3 (dl=3) branch; deadness unchanged because 0x42D680 is unreachable with dl=3.
closed_notes.round8_goldbox_label: the round-8 identification of 0x47ADB4 as '确定' was a mis-decode: raw bytes B1 DD C0 FC decode as '陛傈'; the only '确定' (C8 B7 B6 A8) in the binary is the login-screen string at 0x7A371.
closed_notes.packet_layout_correction: 0x405 packet is {dword amount, word 0x405, word 0, word 0, word 0} - the msg id sits at [dst+4], the amount dword at [dst] (0x452940: [eax]=dword arg3, [eax+4]=word arg2, [eax+6]=word arg4, [eax+8]=word arg5, [eax+0xA]=word arg6).
